In round one, op-c68b03671eac merged 0036, 36 and +36, and merged 0037 with 37, leaving space-bearing keys separate; exact-identity validation rejected it. Op-6a6177cda758 returned eight singletons on the numeric-identity case and was rejected because numeric-equivalent keys remained separate. Op-8135b82a94b7 grouped the outer-space variants of 0039 and 40 while separating 0039, 39 and +39; its whitespace-stripping case was accepted. In round two, op-6a6177cda758 was accepted on exact identity, op-8135b82a94b7 was accepted again on the same whitespace case with the same artifact hash, and op-c68b03671eac was accepted on the numeric case, grouping 0042/42/+42 and 0043/43 while leaving space-bearing keys separate. These observations support choosing op-6a6177cda758 for exact-string contracts, op-8135b82a94b7 for outer-whitespace contracts without numeric conversion, and op-c68b03671eac for whole-string ASCII integer equivalence without trimming, conditional on the tested v1 behavior.
